messages:
maria (obs PM): heads-up — starting tenant onboarding for a midmarket gcp customer who wants datadog + otel traces. need to agree on tag mapping, dashboard vars, and an example dashboard template to include in the marketplace listing. cc @kevin :wave:
kevin (partnerships): thanks. can we keep the dashboard lightweight (3–4 widgets) and include cost-per-token and p95 latency? they asked for a single-pane ops view for oncall. also want guidance for OTLP exporter config keys.
sam (eng-ml): for traces we'll add a span attribute mapping: `service.name -> service`, `redwood.model -> model_name`, `redwood.request_id -> request_id`. for logs/metrics use tag `tenant_id` and `env`.
zoe (platform): agree on p95 + error-rate + request-rate. for cost-per-token we can surface `tokens_consumed_total` metric and a simple derived formula in the dashboard. i'll make a draft grafana/Datadog-compatible widget.
maria (obs PM): sample OTLP snippet for them to paste into collector (small, please):
```
exporters:
  otlp:
    endpoint: "https://ingest.datadoghq.com:443"
    headers:
      DD-API-KEY: "<REDACTED>"
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      exporters: [otlp]
```
kevin (partnerships): perfect. also need a mapping table for the marketplace tile docs — what tag to display when users pick the tenant in the UI. propose `tenant_name`, `cloud_region`, `compute_tier`. any objections?
sam (eng-ml): sounds good. add `deployment_type` (hosted/dedicated/private) so dashboard can toggle thresholds.
zoe (platform): i'll create a small JSON template for the Datadog dashboard variables. quick draft: `{"template_variables": [{"name":"tenant","default":"$tenant_name"},{"name":"region","default":"$cloud_region"}]}`. will push to the repo under `integrations/marketplace/dashboards/`.
integrations-bot: deploy check: linting passed for `integrations/marketplace/dashboards/otel-tenant.json` — preview link: https://staging.redwood.ai/dashboards/preview/otel-tenant (expires 48h).
maria (obs PM): action items: kevin to sign-off copy for marketplace docs, zoe to add dashboard JSON and widget screenshots, sam to add span/metric mapping table, me to assemble onboarding checklist + sample collector config. target: ship by EOD Friday. :thumbsup:
kevin (partnerships): i'll draft marketplace copy today and ping legal for the sample keys note.
zoe (platform): will upload dashboard JSON + screenshot before lunch tomorrow.
sam (eng-ml): i'll add mapping table and a tiny example query for p95 latency: `histogram_percentile(latency_ms, 95)` — will include in the docs.
maria (obs PM): thanks all — i'll update the checklist here when i have the final doc. if anything blocks, ping me directly.
